paper_title: Activated leukocyte cell adhesion molecule and prognosis in acute ischemic stroke
study_population: 244 adults with acute ischemic stroke, followed for 47 months; serum ALCAM sampled at presentation, days 1–5, and 6 months.
primary_human_evidence: Admission ALCAM above the fourth quartile independently predicted long-term mortality after adjustment for age, stroke severity, CRP, troponin, and cardiac/renal failure (adjusted HR 2.05, 95% CI 1.11–3.76).
rationale: Qualifies as a post-event protein measurement and outcome association in a primary human ischemic-stroke cohort.
curator_notes: Additional PMID 21862985 is a duplicate-indexed record; use PMID 21757661 for the study.

paper_title: CD84 Links T Cell and Platelet Activity in Cerebral Thrombo-Inflammation in Acute Stroke
study_population: Acute ischemic-stroke thrombectomy research including direct human arterial blood sampling from the occluded cerebral circulation; animal experiments are also included in the paper.
primary_human_evidence: The paper reports local shedding of platelet CD84 in blood directly sampled from the ischemic cerebral circulation in humans.
rationale: Qualifies based on direct human post-event protein measurement; mechanistic mouse experiments are not used as label evidence.
curator_notes: Human evidence is compartment- and procedure-specific; not a general plasma biomarker claim.

paper_title: Plasma Galectin-4 Levels Are Increased after Stroke in Mice and Humans
study_population: Population-based Malmö Preventive Project Re-Examination cohort, 1,688 adults including 59 with prevalent ischemic stroke.
primary_human_evidence: Human participants with prevalent ischemic stroke had higher plasma Gal-4; adjusted association OR 1.52 (95% CI 1.01–2.30, p=0.048).
rationale: Qualifies as a post-event human plasma measurement associated with prevalent ischemic stroke. The mouse experiments are not used for the label.
curator_notes: Population mainly older white European men; cross-sectional association does not establish timing or causality.

paper_title: Identification of Blood Biomarkers in Ischemic Stroke by Integrated Analysis of Metabolomics and Proteomics
study_population: Serum discovery set of 44 ischemic-stroke patients and 44 matched controls; validation sets of 30 cases/30 controls and 50 cases/50 controls.
primary_human_evidence: Untargeted serum proteomics identified PRTN3 among proteins distinguishing ischemic-stroke patients from controls; PRTN3 was included in the study’s four-marker logistic model.
rationale: Qualifies as a post-event protein measurement in primary human ischemic-stroke case-control and validation cohorts.
curator_notes: Study’s multianalyte discovery model is not a performance result for this sequence classifier.

paper_title: CT hyperdense cerebral artery sign reflects distinct proteomic composition in acute ischemic stroke thrombus
study_population: Thromboembolic material from 24 patients with acute ischemic stroke undergoing thrombectomy; 14 had a hyperdense cerebral artery sign and 10 did not.
primary_human_evidence: Mass-spectrometry detected bleomycin hydrolase as differentially abundant in HCAS-positive versus HCAS-negative stroke thrombi (p=0.007, Z=2.44).
rationale: Qualifies as a post-event protein measurement associated with an acute ischemic-stroke thrombus imaging feature. This is a highly selected thrombectomy sample, not a stroke-versus-control comparison.
curator_notes: Restricted to retrieved thrombi and CT imaging subgroup; interpret narrowly.

study_population: 60 patients with acute carotid-territory ischemic stroke (30 atherothrombotic and 30 cardioembolic subtypes) and 20 stroke-free controls.
primary_human_evidence: Serum CCL15 was elevated in atherothrombotic ischemic stroke compared with controls and was higher in atherothrombotic than cardioembolic cases.
rationale: Qualifies as a post-event serum measurement associated with ischemic-stroke subtype in primary human research.
curator_notes: Small single-centre cohort; subtype result needs replication.

rationale: Qualifies as a post-event serum measurement associated with ischemic stroke and subtype in primary human research.
